service_def.name: PrimitiveEndEffector
service_def.description: This service is the low level interface to an end effector. The End Effector is a one degree of freedom manipulator, usually mounted on the end of an n-degree of freedom manipulator.
service_def.assumptions: Messages may be delayed, lost, or reordered.

message_def.name: QueryEndEffectorSpecification
message_def.description: This message shall cause the receiving service to reply to the requestor with a ID 4632h: ReportEndEffectorSpecification message.

fixed_field.name: MessageID
fixed_field.interpretation: A two byte field to hold the message ID of a message

message_def.name: QueryEndEffectorEffort
message_def.description: This message shall cause the receiving service to reply to the requestor with a ID 4633h: ReportEndEffectorEffort message.

fixed_field.name: MessageID
fixed_field.interpretation: A two byte field to hold the message ID of a message

message_def.name: SetEndEffectorEffort
message_def.description: This message is used to control a single degree of freedom end effector in an open loop fashion. The command states the percentage level of effort that the end effector should exercise. The mapping of effort to end effector behavior (open/close gripper, turn a screw driver, activate a welder) is implementation specific.

fixed_field.name: MessageID
fixed_field.interpretation: A two byte field to hold the message ID of a message

message_def.name: ReportEndEffectorSpecification
message_def.description: This message provides the specifications of a one degree of freedom end effector.

fixed_field.name: MessageID
fixed_field.interpretation: A two byte field to hold the message ID of a message

fixed_field.name: ParentId
fixed_field.interpretation: 4 byte JAUS identifier of the manipulator on which this end effector is mounted

message_def.name: ReportEndEffectorEffort
message_def.description: This message is used to provide the receiver the percent effort that is currently being applied to the end effector.

fixed_field.name: MessageID
fixed_field.interpretation: A two byte field to hold the message ID of a message
